About our North Waco clinic

One team, working together

Welcome to Anthony Medical and Chiropractic Center. Our North Waco chiropractors help people live with less pain, stay active, and feel their best through natural and medical wellness care. Whether you are seeking relief from chronic pain, recovering from an injury, or working toward better health, the team builds a plan around you.

At this office we specialize in chiropractic care, therapeutic massage, Xeomin treatments, B-12 injections, and medical weight loss programs. The goal is to restore balance, improve function, and help you feel your best.

Why our approach is different

We treat the person, not just the problem

Chiropractic care and therapeutic massage together, so the neural, muscular, and skeletal systems are cared for as one. Providers explain the condition and fit the plan to your goals. We accept most major insurance plans and can verify coverage.

01

Root-Cause Healing

We focus on correcting underlying dysfunctions, not just easing symptoms.

02

Team Collaboration

Our medical and chiropractic professionals coordinate care for your best possible outcome.

03

Science-Based Therapies

From manipulation and manual therapy to decompression, assisted stretching, and corrective exercise, each treatment is chosen because it is backed by results and research.

04

Tailored Treatment Plans

Every patient's care plan is designed around their unique diagnosis.

05

Affordable, Honest Care

We balance a high standard of care with practical, cost-conscious options.

06

Confidence in Results

Our patients come for pain relief, improved function, and a return to activity, and they say so in their own words.

Visit our office

Find us in North Waco

Our North Waco clinic at 1139 N Loop 340 is conveniently located just minutes from Walmart, H-E-B, Starbucks, and the Bellmead City Center retail area. Positioned directly off Loop 340 and only a few minutes from I-35, we offer easy access for patients from Bellmead, Lacy Lakeview, Elm Mott, and the Northcrest neighborhoods. We are close to major restaurants such as Chick-fil-A, Whataburger, and Panda Express, KFC, Burger King, and Cracker Barrel as well as medical facilities including Ascension Providence and the Waco VA Clinic. This makes our North Waco location ideal for commuters, families, and local residents seeking fast and convenient chiropractic and wellness care.

Frequently asked questions

Quick answers to common questions

See all frequently asked questions

Do you accept insurance?

Yes. This office accepts most health insurance and will walk you through your coverage. The insurance page lists the plans named on the current site. New patient specials are cash-pay rates, and sharing your insurance when you book may reduce the cost of a visit.

What should I expect on a first visit?

The office describes five things: clear expectations before you arrive, communication that keeps your goals at the center, dedication to the right amount of care, collaboration on the options, and appreciation for the trust you place in the team. The what-to-expect page has their wording.

What are the new patient specials?

$59 for an initial consultation, chiropractic adjustment, and 30-minute massage. $89 for an initial consultation, chiropractic adjustment, and 60-minute massage. $89 for an initial consultation, acupuncture session, and chiropractic adjustments or a 30-minute massage. Cash-pay rates.

Where are you and when are you open?

1139 N Loop 340, Waco, TX 76705. Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 6:00pm. Saturday and Sunday, closed. Call (254) 799-8343.
